paper_title: First Results from Axion Haloscope at CAPP around 10.7 $μ$eV
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (approximate, from KSVZ scaling)
notes: Haloscope search near 10.7 ueV. Two sensitivity levels: ~KSVZ over 10.7126-10.7186 ueV and ~9x KSVZ (8-10x) over 10.16-11.37 ueV. KSVZ g_agamma at this mass ~8e-16 to 1e-15 GeV^-1; the paper does not tabulate explicit g_agamma values so the coupling values here are rough estimates from KSVZ scaling (KSVZ ~ 0.8e-15 GeV^-1 near 2.6 GHz, times 9 ~ 7e-15; approximate). Values should be treated as order-of-magnitude only.
